title: Sound — Where It Stands
thesis: The survey's biggest surprise: memory said 'plan, SN0 next', the code says one of the most fully-realized planes in the library, SN0-SN6 and a sonification series shipped and closed. miniaudio is vendored and split into two DLLs, there is an owned Zig sound graph (Web-Audio-shaped), FFT-backed analysis, and a real lock-free real-time callback that does no allocation, no lock, and never re-enters the Haro VM. What it refuses on purpose: MIDI, spatial/HRTF, plugin hosting, notation; and reverb is absent even from the effect palette.

lanes.note: sinkCallback does no allocation, no lock, never re-enters the Haro VM; SPSC lock-free circular buffer, underruns counted, worst-callback microseconds tracked
Vendored miniaudio backends per OS: open/start/stop/close, a stzSoundTransport face, an honest report when no device; split into decode and device DLLs
An owned node graph (miniaudio's own graph disabled): OSC/SOURCE/GAIN/MIX/PAN/FILTER/DELAY/ENVELOPE over planar buses, topological and cycle-free
soundanalysis.zig on the shared fft.zig: Hann spectrum, threaded spectrogram, onset detection, tempo estimation, LUFS loudness, dominant frequency
stzEarcons (66 methods), stzVoice/stzVoicePool, stzListener (closed grammar), and the SS1-SS5 sonification series; no mainstream audio library offers this
Decodes WAV/MP3/FLAC/OGG via miniaudio with resample and channel conversion; encode is WAV/FLAC only, MP3/OGG out return UNSUPPORTED
Band-limited oscillators (polyBLEP/polyBLAMP) for sine/square/saw/triangle plus ADSR, f64, unit-tested; no wavetable, FM, additive or granular
Microphone capture through the same device layer and callback discipline; multi-device selection and format negotiation stay basic
A producer thread feeds the lock-free circular buffer the callback drains, bounded at MAX_STREAMS=16, with StreamStart/Stop/Drain; no network streaming
stzSoundPlot and stzSoundGrid render waveforms and spectrograms through the library's own graphics plane as SVG/PNG, plus a browser guard harness
RBJ biquad filters (lowpass/highpass/bandpass), a feedback delay, gain and pan; no reverb (absent even as a named node), compressor, chorus or distortion
None, stated in writing as deliberate non-goals: MIDI, notation, 3D/HRTF spatial, time-stretching and VST/CLAP hosting are OUT until asked

standouts: A lock-free real-time callback: no alloc, no lock, no Haro re-entry, guarded down to worst-callback microseconds
An owned Zig sound graph, Web-Audio-shaped, not a wrapper
librosa-grade analysis: spectrogram, onsets, tempo and LUFS on the shared engine FFT
A sonification / earcon / voice layer no mainstream audio library offers
gaps: Reverb and a fuller effect palette (compressor, chorus, distortion)
MP3 / OGG encode to close the read-broad / write-narrow asymmetry
MIDI input, spatial/HRTF and plugin hosting (deliberate non-goals)
dated: Read from the source on 2026-09-16, from a read-only main worktree -- base/sound; engine sound.zig, soundgraph.zig, soundanalysis.zig, audiodev.zig, sounddsp.zig, soundring.zig, soundwasm.zig + vendored miniaudio 0.11.25; guards under test/sound (31 files + a web-audio harness)
